column1: # Run directory labels (cross-section item 1.26, 09.C1): a label, a tab, and the label a run directory
# gets: per Unicode code point, each run of code points outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] becomes one -, leading
# and trailing - are trimmed, and the result is cut to 44 characters. Section 09's C++ copy of the rule
# and the frontend's Java copy read this one table, so the two agree (section 12, Frontend contracts).
# An empty second column is an empty label: the directory is then run_<timestamp>.
A very long session name that goes on beyond forty-four characters
